cards.ex: Telling a joke is a good way to break the ice at a party.
cards.exUz: Hazil aytish, ziyofatda muzni eritishning yaxshi usuli.
cards.uzDef: Suhbatni boshlashga yordam beradigan narsa aytish yoki qilish.

cards.ex: Let's catch up over coffee next week.
cards.exUz: Keling, kelasi hafta kofe ustida gaplashib olaylik.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt ko'rishmagan odam bilan xabar almashish.

cards.ex: Hey John, how's it going?
cards.exUz: Salom Jon, ishlaring qalay?

cards.ex: It was great seeing you! Let's keep in touch.
cards.exUz: Sizni ko'rganim juda yaxshi bo'ldi! Aloqada bo'lib turaylik.

cards.ex: Hey Sarah, what's new with you?
cards.exUz: Salom Sara, senga nima gaplar?
cards.uzDef: Oxirgi marta ko'rishgandan beri nima yangilik bo'lganini so'rash.

cards.ex: I missed the meeting, can you fill me in?
cards.exUz: Men yig'ilishni o'tkazib yubordim, menga ma'lumot bera olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida barcha tafsilotlarni aytib berish.

cards.ex: I ran into my old school friend in Tokyo. Small world!
cards.exUz: Men Tokioda eski maktabdosh do'stimni uchratdim. Dunyoyu kichik!
cards.uzDef: Tasodifiy uchrashuv qanchalik g'alati ekanligini bildirish.

cards.ex: Thanks for helping me. - No worries!
cards.exUz: Yordamingiz uchun rahmat. - Xavotir olma!
cards.uzDef: Muammo yo'q, hammasi joyida degan ma'noda.

cards.ex: Let's get together for dinner sometime.
cards.exUz: Qachondir kechki ovqatga uchrashaylik.

cards.ex: What have you been up to? - Same old, same old.
cards.exUz: Nima bilan shug'ullanib yuribsan? - O'sha-o'sha.
cards.uzDef: Hech narsa o'zgarmadi, odatdagidek degan ma'noda.

cards.ex: I'm doing well, how about you?
cards.exUz: Men yaxshiman, siz-chi?

cards.ex: Hey Mark, good to see you again.
cards.exUz: Salom Mark, seni yana ko'rganim yaxshi.

cards.ex: Hey, heard anything good lately?
cards.exUz: Salom, oxirgi paytlarda yaxshi yangilik eshitdingmi?

cards.ex: We're making plans for our summer vacation.
cards.exUz: Biz yozgi ta'tilimiz uchun reja tuzmoqdamiz.

cards.ex: It's been a while since we last met.
cards.exUz: Oxirgi marta ko'rishganimizga ancha bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Oxirgi marta ko'rishganingizga ancha vaqt bo'lganini bildirish.

cards.ex: Hey, what are you up to this weekend?
cards.exUz: Salom, bu dam olish kunlari nima qilyapsan?
cards.uzDef: Kimdir hozir nima bilan shug'ullanayotganini so'rash.

cards.ex: How's the project going? - So far so good.
cards.exUz: Loyiha qanday ketyapti? - Hozircha yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Hozircha hamma narsa yaxshi ekanligini bildirish.

cards.ex: Hey, how's life treating you?
cards.exUz: Salom, hayot senga qanday munosabatda bo'lyapti?
cards.uzDef: Kimdirning hayoti haqida umumiy savol berish.

cards.ex: So, any big news from your side?
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, siz tomonda katta yangiliklar bormi?
cards.uzDef: Oxirgi paytlarda muhim yangiliklar bo'lganini so'rash.

cards.ex: I'll get around to cleaning the garage eventually.
cards.exUz: Men oxir-oqibat garajni tozalashga vaqt topaman.

cards.ex: It was great chatting with you. Let's do lunch sometime.
cards.exUz: Siz bilan suhbatlashish juda yaxshi bo'ldi. Qachondir tushlik qilaylik.

cards.ex: What are you doing tonight? - The usual, watching TV.
cards.exUz: Bugun kechqurun nima qilmoqchisan? - Odatdagidek, televizor ko'raman.

cards.ex: So, what do you do for a living?
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, tirikchilik uchun nima ish qilasiz?

cards.ex: Wow, John! Long time no see!
cards.exUz: Voy, Jon! Ko'rishmaganimizga ancha bo'ldi!
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt ko'rishmagan odamni uchratganda ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: It's nice to see you. How's your family doing?
cards.exUz: Sizni ko'rganim yaxshi. Oilangiz qalay?

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu loyiha ustida ishni boshlaymiz.

cards.ex: I'll swing by your office later this week.
cards.exUz: Men bu hafta oxirida sizning ofisingizga qisqa tashrif buyuraman.

cards.ex: Tell me, anything exciting happen lately?
cards.exUz: Ayting-chi, yaqinda qiziq narsa bo'ldimi?

cards.ex: You're on the right track with this idea.
cards.exUz: Siz bu g'oya bilan to'g'ri yo'ldasiz.

cards.ex: It was great talking to you. Chat soon!
cards.exUz: Siz bilan suhbatlashish juda yaxshi bo'ldi. Tez orada gaplashamiz!
cards.uzDef: Tez orada yana bog'lanish istagini bildirish.
